questions.question: What is the primary architectural difference between CSS Flexbox and CSS Grid?
options: Flexbox is 1-dimensional (row or column), while CSS Grid is 2-dimensional (rows and columns simultaneously)
Flexbox is for text, Grid is for images
questions.explanation: Flexbox manages layout in one dimension at a time, whereas CSS Grid controls both rows and columns simultaneously in two dimensions.

questions.question: What does the 'fr' unit represent in CSS Grid?
options: A fraction of the available free space in the grid container
questions.explanation: The 'fr' unit represents a fraction of the unused available space after fixed pixels and gaps have been deducted.

questions.question: Which grid declaration creates an automatically responsive multi-column layout without requiring media queries?
questions.explanation: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr)) automatically calculates how many 280px columns fit and stretches them to fill the container.

questions.question: How do you make a grid item span across two column tracks?
questions.explanation: grid-column: span 2 instructs the item to occupy two column tracks in the grid.

questions.question: Which property allows developers to name layout regions visually as ASCII-art strings (e.g., 'header header' 'sidebar main')?
questions.explanation: grid-template-areas assigns named areas across the grid grid, allowing semantic placement via grid-area.
